details: US President Trump has proposed new tariffs on imports from 14 trading partners, including China and the European Union. This move, aimed at addressing perceived excess industrial capacity, is anticipated to reignite global trade tensions, potentially leading to increased inflation and broader economic uncertainty.
title: US Proposes Tariffs on 14 Trading Partners

details: Crude oil prices have increased following reports of Yemen's Houthi rebels attacking Saudi Arabia's largest oil refinery and ships being struck by mines in the Strait of Hormuz. These incidents are intensifying concerns over global oil supply and raising geopolitical risk premiums in the energy markets.
title: Oil Prices Climb Amid Middle East Supply Concerns

details: Bitcoin's price dropped below $60,000, mirroring a broader sell-off across financial assets. This downturn is attributed to persistent US inflation, increasing expectations of further interest rate hikes by the Federal Reserve, and significant capital outflows from US spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds (ETFs).
title: Bitcoin Falls Below $60,000 Amid Broad Market Sell-Off

details: South Korea's financial regulator has introduced draft legislation designed to permit local banks to issue stablecoins. This move could potentially ease a nine-year prohibition on Initial Coin Offerings (ICOs), aiming to enhance transparency and build investor confidence within the digital asset market.
title: South Korea Unveils Draft Stablecoin Rules, Easing ICO Ban

details: Global technology stocks, particularly those related to artificial intelligence like Nvidia, have experienced a significant sell-off. This market movement is driven by concerns over AI financing, reported accounting irregularities, and a general climate of unease among investors, contributing to a cautious sentiment across broader financial markets.
title: Global Tech Stocks Drop Amid AI Sector Concerns
